t: Durango Men’s PRCA Collection Caiman Belly Western Boot (DDB0471)
d:
Details 
 Engineered for rodeo performance, the PRCA Collection by Durango® is hand-crafted with superior comfort, premium leathers and a low ground feel approved by world champions.
 The men’s 13” Cognac/Cigar style features caiman belly foot, full-grain leather shaft, caiman belly underlay in pull straps, fully leather lined and has a thin leather insole with heel tuck and memory foam. This style also features the patented fiberglass Dually Shank System™ for twice the midfoot and torsion stability, rolled shank area, hand nailed and stained genuine leather outsole, ¾ genuine Goodyear® welt construction and genuine leather welt with double row cotton stitch.
 This style is finished off with a high-abrasion resistant rubber heel lift, leather stacked heel base, 1 ¼” stockman heel, square toe and has the iconic ProRodeo logo branded inside the shaft and on the outsole of the boot.
 The new PRCA collection combines classic western design with the latest in performance technology, making these boots rodeo ready right out of the box by providing the right balance of protection, comfort, and style, custom built for the rodeo. Get a pair today!
